firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
We are pre-registering a confirmatory analysis before reading any outcome of our held-out events.

Claim under test: in ADK 1.x compaction (as used by the scorer), agents that had already edited the repository abandon their working file and regress in task phase more after compaction than agents that had only been reading.

Exploratory evidence came from our dev runs. The confirmatory test uses 125 compaction events from 331 tasks mined from 7 public repositories outside the competition, none analysed yet. The design also pre-registers a causal replay (re-injecting the agent's own git diff after the summary).

SHA-256 of the frozen files:
PREREG_CONFIRMATORIO.md  97c42735e47374d962e2aaa4f0d3f9c84977331bfc4dc7c5f4a954dc2a35884f
analise_confirmatoria.py 9b488cb4b8d5d6be9926eb3abf19dcff77565b58b4bb5035b65d2216504a0e46

Both files will be released with the paper so anyone can check the hashes and rerun the analysis.
